headline: Anthropic shares fall nearly 6% in premarket trading after Nasdaq debut
body: CNBC says Anthropic fell nearly 6% in Friday premarket trading after its Nasdaq debut. The AI lab was 5.6% down at 4.23am ET, with Nvidia down 1.66% and AMD down 4.12%. The stock had closed Thursday at $97.17, up 17% on its first day.
note: Investors had hoped the debut would revive the AI trade, which CNBC says has been under pressure over capex fears. The premarket drop came as Nvidia and AMD also fell.

figure.label: Anthropic premarket change on Friday, per CNBC

evidence.text: Anthropic fell nearly 6% in Friday premarket trading after a historic debut on Nasdaq.
The AI lab was 5.6% down in premarket trading at 4.23am ET on Friday.
Nvidia was down 1.66% and AMD fell 4.12%.
Anthropic soared 17% in its first day of trading on Thursday, after the company completed the biggest initial public offering on record, topping SpaceX' s historic debut in June.
The stock closed at $97.17 per share.
Investors had hoped that Anthropic's debut would revitalize the AI trade, which has come under pressure in recent months amid fears over capex spending.
Anthropic fell nearly 6% on Friday morning after a historic debut on Nasdaq, as AI fears continued to cause a selloff with Nvidia and AMD lower.
